definitions.gloss: facing each other; sitting opposite; face to face
definitions.explanation: A seating or spatial arrangement where two people or things are positioned directly across from each other.

examples.japanese: {向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}った→座る：00757_suwaru⟧。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{気|き}まずい→気まずい：06536_kimazui⟧。
examples.english: The facing seats on the train are a little awkward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}んで→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧{向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}り→座る：00757_suwaru⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}し→話す：00467_hanasu⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The two sat across from each other at the table and quietly began to talk.

notes:
Describes a spatial arrangement where two things or people directly face one another. Most commonly used for seating arrangements on trains, at tables, or in waiting rooms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧: to sit facing each other
- {向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: facing seats
- {向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: the house directly opposite
- {向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to arrange facing each other

USAGE:
Typically used as an adverbial phrase with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ ({向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧) or as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ ({向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧). On Japanese trains, some cars have {向|む}かい{合|あ}わせ seating (box seats facing each other) while others have forward-facing rows.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{向|む}かい→向かい：03750_mukai⟧: across the way, opposite (refers to a location across from you)
- ⟦{対面|たいめん}→対面：10377_taimen⟧: face-to-face meeting or encounter (emphasizes the act of meeting rather than the spatial arrangement)
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧: the front; directly in front of something
